visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a bright, modern bedroom, a small girl with two pigtails is seen sitting on a red and wooden rocking horse toy on a light-colored wooden floor. The camera captures her from a high angle as she begins to rock back and forth on the toy. (2) The girl hops off the rocking horse and begins to push it by its handle toward the bedroom door. The room features a bed with a grey comforter and a white bedside cabinet. The lighting is soft and natural, coming from a nearby window with blinds. (3) As she pushes the toy into a hallway, the camera follows her from a low angle. She maneuvers the horse through a glass-paneled sliding door into another room where a woman is sitting at a white desk, busy working on a laptop. (4) The girl continues her task, pushing the horse around the workspace and back out into the hallway. The environment is cluttered with various household items, including a robot vacuum station and shelves filled with toys and boxes. (5) In a series of cuts, the child is shown persistently moving the rocking horse back and forth between different areas of the home, occasionally struggling with its weight. The woman periodically looks over and speaks to her while continuing her work. (6) Finally, the girl leaves the rocking horse in the middle of the hallway. The video transitions to a pink screen featuring an animated version of the girl holding a peach, with the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' appearing below.
